decisions.expression:
case value
  when 1..3
    "small"
  when Integer
    "integer"
  else
    "other"
  end

case load_value.call
  when 1
    "first"
  when 2
    "second"
  else
    "miss"
  end

case mode
                when 'empty' then []
                when 'invalid' then [42]
                else [ArgumentError, IOError]
                end

rescue IOError
    retry if attempts < 3
    raise

case mode
  when 'raise' then raise ArgumentError, 'new error'
  when 'fail' then fail IOError, 'failed'
  when 'explicit' then raise RangeError.new('explicit')
  else
    begin
      raise TypeError, 'original'
    rescue TypeError
      raise
    end
  end

case mode
  when 'exit' then exit 7
  when 'abort' then abort 'stopped'
  when 'immediate' then exit! 7
  end

case value
  in Integer then "integer"
  else "other"
  end

case value
  in Integer then "integer"
  end

case value
  in [Integer] if allowed then "match"
  else "fallback"
  end

case value
  in [Integer] unless allowed then "match"
  else "fallback"
  end

case value
  in Integer then "integer"
  in nil then "nil"
  in /abc/ then "text"
  else "other"
  end

case value
  in [head, *tail] then [head, tail]
  else nil
  end

case value
  in [*, Integer => number, *] then number
  else nil
  end

case value
  in Integer => number then number
  else nil
  end

case value
  in Point[a, b] then [a, b]
  else nil
  end

case {users: users}
  in {users: [{name:}, *]} then name
  else nil
  end

case {age: age}
  in {age: Integer => years} if years >= 18 && (trace << "permission"; permitted)
    "adult"
  else
    "other"
  end
